cafes.title: Cafes near you
cafes.subtitle: Specialty coffee, matcha, tea and the pastries that go with them — delivered, or ready when you walk in.
cafes.feature1Body: Single-origin espresso, slow filter and matcha whisked to order.
cafes.feature2Body: Most cafes here start pouring before seven, so a delivery lands with breakfast.
cafes.feature3Body: Oat, soy and almond options on every espresso drink — no surcharge surprises.

homeChefs.title: Home chefs
homeChefs.subtitle: Cooks in their own kitchens, making the food they grew up on. Ordered ahead, cooked fresh, never sitting under a heat lamp.
homeChefs.feature1Body: Identity, address and food-safety checks before a chef can take a single order.
homeChefs.feature2Body: Nothing is batch-made. Lead times are longer than a restaurant, and that is the point.
homeChefs.feature3Body: Many chefs cook on set days or take orders the night before — the times are on each profile.

cloudKitchens.title: Cloud kitchens
cloudKitchens.subtitle: Delivery-only kitchens with no dining room to slow them down. Tighter menus, faster tickets, lower prices.
cloudKitchens.feature1Body: Short menus and one job — food out the door. Most tickets clear in under twenty minutes.
cloudKitchens.feature2Body: Broth, sauce and crisp things packed apart, so nothing arrives soft.
cloudKitchens.feature3Body: No front of house means the saving lands on the menu instead of the rent.
